skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts and terminology in the field of finance and monetary economics.
Analyze fundamental activities in the field of finance and monetary economics.
Apply theoretical knowledge to practical research in finance and monetary economics.
Analyze the relationship between components of the financial system.
Analyze differences between various types of corporate assets and sources of capital.
Analyze differences between components of the financial market.
Apply interest rate calculations and time value of money to make investment decisions.
Discuss and analyze measures to address government budget deficits.
Analyze risks and returns of financial instruments to make investment portfolio choices.
Develop independent and dynamic group work skills, including presentation skills.
